suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease transformation. Require established primary myelofibrosis followed by documented blast/leukemic transformation, specifically AML-compatible disease. Source supports leukemic progression risk; do not generalize to unrelated leukemia types. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Primary Myelofibrosis and Leukemia (Acute & Chronic)
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
